spec.research_question: Does vote depth across seven frozen B component tickets associate with OOS winning-number membership under round-clustered uncertainty?
spec.training_cutoff_rule: Each cached OOS prediction for target t must have training_through_round=t-1; only pre-target frozen component tickets are used.
spec.primary_metric: mean main-number hits per target round
spec.comparator: same target-round cached B component forecasts and equal-rank B where applicable
spec.baseline: exact uniform 6/45 distribution; simulated same-target random tickets when specified
spec.multiplicity_correction: Holm step-down for registered family of contrasts; descriptive outputs labelled exploratory
spec.tie_break: lower number for score ties; source component order retained
spec.novelty_signature: per-target per-number depths 0..7; 45 numbers retained as a round cluster; 2000 round-cluster bootstrap replicates; 100 random seven-ticket ensembles per target.
spec.bootstrap_unit: whole target round with 45 number outcomes
